common.comingSoonTitle: This page is on its way
common.comingSoonBody: We are still building this section. Please check back soon.

donate.name: Your name
donate.tier5: connects one family to a safe, local water source.
donate.tier10: pays for a year of school supplies for one pupil.
donate.tier25: trains a village water committee member to keep a tap running.
donate.phone: You approve the payment on your own phone with MTN or Orange Mobile Money.
donate.monthlyNote: Each monthly gift is a separate Mobile Money payment. This pays your first gift now, and you can come back to give again next month.
donate.noScript: Giving online needs JavaScript. Please turn it on, or contact us to give another way.
donate.errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
donate.errAmount: Enter an amount between {min} and {max} XAF.
donate.errInvalid: Some details are not valid. Please check the form and try again.
donate.errRate: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
donate.errConfig: Online payments are not available right now. Please try again later or contact us.
donate.errUnavailable: The payment service did not respond. Nothing was charged. Please try again in a moment.
donate.errServer: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was charged. Please try again.
donate.errNetwork: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.intro: We are confirming your Mobile Money payment.
thanks.checkingBody: If you have not yet approved the payment on your phone, please do so now. This page updates by itself.
thanks.retrying: Connection problem. We are still trying.
thanks.completedBody: We received {amount} XAF. Thank you for standing with us.
thanks.completedMonthly: You chose monthly giving. Each month's gift is a separate payment, so please come back and give again next month.
thanks.failedTitle: The payment did not go through
thanks.failedBody: It may have been cancelled or timed out. If money left your account, please contact us with the time and amount.
thanks.timeoutBody: We have not heard back yet. Approving can take a few minutes. Check your Mobile Money messages, then check again.
thanks.notFoundTitle: We could not find this donation
thanks.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete. If you were charged, please contact us with the time and amount.
thanks.noScript: This page needs JavaScript to show your payment status. If you approved the payment, Mobile Money will send you a confirmation message.
